[SWS_DM_01217] Refresh timeouts
⌈
If an application calls the method
ara::diag::ClientAuthenticationHandle::Refresh of the class ara::-
diag::ClientAuthenticationHandle, the Diagnostic Server instance
shall perform one of the following:
• If
the
ara::diag::ClientAuthenticationHandle
was
returned
by
the
ara::diag::ClientAuthentication::OverrideDefaultRoles
method, refresh the time period for which the OverrideDefaultRoles is valid.
Refer [SWS_DM_01209].
• If the ara::diag::ClientAuthenticationHandle was returned by the
ara::diag::ClientAuthentication::Authenticate
method,
refresh
the client inactivity time period. Refer [SWS_DM_01210].
⌋
